name: Live TV (M3U)
description: Your own IPTV channels from M3U playlists (as many as you have, up to 20), with their programme guides from XMLTV.

listing.summary: Watch the channels of your M3U playlists (IPTV subscriptions, public lists) with a programme guide.
listing.description: Paste the address of an M3U playlist in its settings, and optionally of an XMLTV guide (else the one the playlist names); up to 20 playlists, their channels shown together. The channels show in a Live TV section with their programmes; the server plays HLS and MPEG-TS streams. The plugin carries no list of its own.
listing.disclaimer: Only add playlists you are allowed to watch. Playpex is an educational project.

settings.label: Playlists
settings.description: Each playlist's channels are added to the lineup, in this order. Add as many as you have, up to 20.

fields.label: Playlist (M3U)
fields.description: The address of your M3U playlist: http or https, as your provider gives it.

fields.label: Programme guide (XMLTV)
fields.description: Optional: an XMLTV file (.xml or .xml.gz). Empty: the guide the playlist names, if any.

fields.label: Use it
fields.description: Off: its channels leave the lineup, its addresses stay here.

settings.label: Use the guide the playlist names
settings.description: For a playlist without a guide address.

settings.label: Only these groups
settings.description: Group names from any of the playlists. None: every channel.
